name: Crepes & Coffee / Sweetaly Dairy-Free Fruit Sorbetto vs. Cream Gelato
brandOrRestaurant: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Sweetaly artisanal fruit sorbetto (such as mango or raspberry-strained) served at Crepes & Coffee is 100% dairy-free and fat-free, giving you a cold Bear Lake treat without the heavy lactose crash of famous raspberry shakes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a small cup of non-citrus Dairy-Free Fruit Sorbetto (avoid lemon/limoncello sorbetto and seedy berry flavors; or take lactase if choosing dairy Stracciatella/Vanilla gelato).
watchOuts: Skip Lemon/Citrus sorbetto flavors (citrus trigger) and chocolate-hazelnut/pistachio gelato if avoiding nuts
